'''Barrga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] alive during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Based out of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Barrga was a moderately powerful [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and a member of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. He employed several [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], including the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Hylo Visz]], to ferry [[Black market/Legends|black market]] goods and contraband across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During a smuggling run to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the Hutt employed the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Musk (Nikto)|Musk]] and a [[Unidentified Weequay enforcer|Weequay bodyguard]] to ensure Visz's compliance with her orders. Barrga's clients, the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]], double-crossed the Hutt and destroyed Visz's ship, the ''[[Crimson Fleece]]''. Although Musk and the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] were killed, the Mirialan survived the ordeal but decided not to return to Barrga's employ. She instead struck out on her own, eventually becoming the leader of an [[Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent|independent smuggling ring]].<ref name="Smuggler's Vanguard" />
